text:
carla-sales: Heads-up — FinServCorp POC kickoff next Mon. They want a fully air-gapped on‑prem POC. Main asks: upgrade cadence commitments, offline bundle size & signing, support SLA during the POC, and whether we can integrate customer HSM/KMS for image signing. Need eng + security to confirm feasible items for the commercial proposal.

pete-eng: TL;DR — all doable but with constraints. Offline bundles will be delta-friendly but full initial bundle ~3.1GB. Upgrades can be scheduled quarterly by default; we can do monthly hotfix bundles for security patches. Need to confirm if customer expects automated delta apply or manual operator runbook.

elaine-sec: @pete-eng +1. Important: if they're using customer KMS/HSM for signing, we'll need an offline signing integration runbook and an attestation flow. Also require completed security questionnaire (they sent a short form) before we allow private deployment. PCI implications — registry access must be locked down.

sam-devex: For POC, we usually provide a one-off signed bundle and a validation script. We can generate checksums and a verification helper: 

```
# verify bundle
sha256sum redwood-bundle-2026-03-01.tar.gz
# expected: 8f2a...b7c
```

We can also provide a small operator container that applies a delta patch when the customer has a staged window.

ada-ops: Operational note — offline install requires a service account for the operator to run with limited privileges. We need to know whether FinServCorp wants us to create a managed operator account (we provide creds on install) or they will create a local service account and we document RBAC. Managed creds add extra compliance/contract work.

julia-sales: Billing/contract question: customer asked if dev/test POC support is covered under standard trial credits or if we need a short-term dedicated seat + SLA. @carla-sales do we want to push dedicated reserved pricing if they ask for monthly patch cadence + 24/7 support during POC?

carla-sales: Let's propose 30-day POC with standard trial support (business hours) but offer an optional add-on for 24/7 support + faster patch SLA at extra cost. We'll flag dedicated reserved pricing if they want long-term private deployment after POC.

pete-eng: Technical blocker to call out in proposal: if they require in-place live upgrades with zero downtime in air-gapped mode, that increases complexity — we need a short design review and ~2 week engineering lead time. Canary/rollbacks in air-gapped envs need local staging mirrors.

elaine-sec: Also require signed NDA + completed security questionnaire. For KMS integration we'll need a stub to verify signatures during bootstrap without ever sending keys out. Recommend HSM-backed signing with locally verifiable cert chain. Add that to the SOW.

sam-devex: I can draft an ops-runbook snippet for the POC: pre-install checklist, network rules (minimal egress for license fetch if allowed), manual bundle verify steps, and rollback steps. Will share tomorrow.

ada-ops: FYI — our offline patch format supports chunked deltas so customers with limited media (USB 16GB) can still update. We do need to know their preferred transport: USB vs local registry mirror vs sneekernet. That affects delivery timeline.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: POC bundle staging -> staging-bucket (internal) on 2026-03-25 03:00 UTC. Notify #eng-runtime when ready.

julia-sales: Action items for proposal: 1) confirm who provides operator/service account 2) confirm KMS/HSM requirement 3) include optional 24/7 SLA pricing 4) attach security questionnaire to SOW. I'll pull pricing grid once we confirm cadence.

carla-sales: Great — can each owner drop a one-paragraph note into the shared POC doc by EOD Fri? I'll prepare the SOW draft based on those notes and the pricing options. :thumbsup:
